additional_info.subject: ID0415686-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / P8 170000834]Issue with charger outlet. CRM:00798002074
additional_info.body:
Hi Team,
Customer have reported issue of AC outlet not working.
First of all, charger is on v6.0.3, We recommend to have charger at v6.1.3.
We have analyzed the charger logs over the period of 4weeks,
We could see the charger is having Error Flag,
RCD_FB1_or_MCB_FC5_AC_Charging
Outlet_AC1_codes
AC Error code:13
We need to inspect the FC5 & FB1, Check if they are tripped,
If So, We need to untrip same and have charging sessions.
Also, We need to check for the feedback line, If it have loose connection.
Do let me know if you have any other query/need clarity.
or You need assistance in the site intervention.
Thank and Best Regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Giridhar "Gary"

additional_info.subject: ID0415686-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / P8 170000834]Issue with charger outlet. CRM:00798002085
additional_info.body:
Hi Team,
We have Error Flags as following:
RCD_FB1_or_MCB_FC5_AC_Charging
Outlet_AC1_codes : AC1 Errorcode:13
Error Code:13 means G_AC_OUTLET_STAT_CODE_FUSE_OR_RCD_TRIPPED
We need to inspect the FC5 & FB1, Check if they are tripped,
If So, We need to untrip same and have charging sessions.
Also, We need to check for the feedback line, If it have loose connection.
Do let me know if you have any other query/need clarity.
or You need assistance in the site intervention.

I think the problem is on one of the 2 parts (FC5 or FB1). Can you plan to replace both please and check the wires ? Indeed, the problem is here since more than a year now so we must correct it.
